coverage: Twenty-two governorates and 335 districts from the 2023 OCHA reference. The 2025 population table covers 333 district records; its adjusted current-resident estimates are aggregated to the matching governorates. District population is withheld where the 333-record population geography cannot support the 335 mapped districts. Administrative geography is not a live control map. Country overviews stay hidden. Shared administrative edges and land frontiers have strokes; coastline and open water do not.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
